interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and relocate utility poles to a dedicated furniture zone to provide a clear, accessible path.

interventions.title: Landscaped Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the vehicle entrance to the minimum necessary for safe operations, shortening the pedestrian exposure time.

interventions.title: Raised Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Continue the sidewalk across the driveway at grade as a raised crossing to slow entering vehicles and reinforce pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Markings
interventions.description: Paint clear crosswalk markings across the driveway to define the pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Vertical Elements
interventions.description: Add street trees on the right side of the road to create a sense of enclosure, which naturally encourages drivers to slow down.

interventions.title: Enhanced Buffer Landscaping
interventions.description: Increase the density of planting in the buffer zone to improve the aesthetic quality and psychological comfort of the walkway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Expansion and Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, wide sidewalk on the right side and widen the existing sidewalk on the left to meet ADA standards.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe walking path for pedestrians in both directions.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Railing or Barrier
interventions.description: Install a crash-rated barrier or a more substantial railing between the roadway and the sidewalk to protect pedestrians from vehicle incursions.

interventions.title: Install Landscaped Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or buffer zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to increase the physical separation between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to increase the distance between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and security at night.

interventions.title: Protective Barriers
interventions.description: Install crash-rated barriers or bollards between the roadway and the sidewalk to physically protect pedestrians.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement measures such as speed humps or lane narrowing to reduce vehicle speeds in this high-risk area.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Add a sidewalk buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or physical barrier between the sidewalk and the roadway to protect pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility crosswalk with signage to facilitate safer movement across the wide arterial.
